response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 41,42,43,44,45,46,47,48 in this chapter.

messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":14,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":14,"text":"My mouth was opened, and shut no more.","verse":41},{"chapter":14,"text":"The Most High gave understanding to the five men, and they wrote by course the things that were told them, in characters which they didn’t know, and they sat forty days. Now they wrote in the day-time, and at night they ate bread.","verse":42},{"chapter":14,"text":"As for me, I spoke in the day, and by night I didn’t hold my tongue.","verse":43},{"chapter":14,"text":"So in forty days, ninety-four books were written.","verse":44},{"chapter":14,"text":"It came to pass, when the forty days were fulfilled, that the Most High spoke to me, saying, “The first books that you have written, publish openly, and let the worthy and unworthy read them;","verse":45},{"chapter":14,"text":"but keep the last seventy, that you may deliver them to those who are wise among your people;","verse":46},{"chapter":14,"text":"for in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.”","verse":47},{"chapter":14,"text":"I did so.","verse":48}]}
